description: Source of truth for access-tag vocabulary used in resources.json. Each dataset carries exactly one access tag (or a defined two-tag pair). When the jq whitelist in acceptance criterion A3 and this file disagree, this file wins.

Free.definition: Zero cost, no account required, no commercial restriction on use.

Non-commercial Use.definition: Free to access but license or Terms of Service restrict commercial use. Always paired with a cost tag (Free or Partially Free).

Partially Free.definition: A material portion of the dataset's primary value proposition is gated behind a paywall or credentialed access. Both the free and gated halves represent primary value. Not applicable when only trivial or reconstructible signals are missing.
examples: Global Factor Library (JKP) — factor returns free, stock-level characteristics require WRDS
Open Source Asset Pricing (C&Z) — 209 of 212 signals free, 3 CRSP-only signals

Restricted.definition: Downloading is permitted (possibly free) but redistribution in any form is explicitly forbidden by the Terms of Service. Thesis appendices, replication packages, and repositories all require separate written permission.
examples: AQR Data Library — ToS bans all redistribution without written consent

Subscription.definition: Paid subscription required to access the primary dataset. Free samples may exist but do not constitute the primary value.
examples: LOBSTER — academic subscription required for full limit order book data

two_tag_patterns.Free + Non-commercial Use: Dataset is free to access but has a non-commercial restriction. Use both tags together.
two_tag_patterns.Partially Free + Non-commercial Use: The free tier is available but carries a non-commercial restriction. Use both tags together.
two_tag_patterns.Free + Restricted: Dataset is free to download but redistribution is forbidden. Use both tags together.

tags.description: One access tag per dataset (or a defined two-tag pair from two_tag_patterns), plus any number of topic tags. Access tags must come from access_labels above.

license.description: SPDX identifier or short human-readable license description. Null when no formal license document exists.

license_notes.description: Human-readable explanation of why the license field is null. Mandatory for null-license entries; null or omitted otherwise.

license_verified_date.description: Date when the license status was last verified from a primary source.

license_source_url.description: URL of the primary source consulted when determining the license.
